tuples.subject: prepayment_charge
tuples.special_circumstance: pre-payment charges on term loans where the bank levies them
tuples.quote: However, in case of term loans, pre-payment charges, if levied by the bank, shall be based on the amount being prepaid.

tuples.subject: prepayment_charge
tuples.special_circumstance: pre-payment charges on closure of cash credit/overdraft facilities before due date
tuples.quote: In case of cash credit/ overdraft facilities, pre-payment charges on closure of the facility before the due date shall be levied on an amount not exceeding the sanctioned limit.

tuples.subject: prepayment_charge
tuples.special_circumstance: all cases other than those mentioned at paragraphs 353(1) and 353(2) above
tuples.quote: In cases other than those mentioned at paragraphs 353(1) and 353(2) above, pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of the bank.
